core_idea: Cinq Assoc. East Section 3 Hong Lu is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist / Support — **Poise** fighter — stack it on yourself; on hit each stack rolls a Potency-based chance to crit for **1.2x** damage, and Count drops by 1 on a successful crit and again at Turn End. Support passive (**I'll Melt Open the Way Out**) buffs your **fastest Speed ally** — pair with a high-Speed attacker.
playstyle_guide:
- **I'll Melt Open the Way Out** amplifies the **fastest Speed ally** — field a high-Speed damage dealer as teammate.
- Skills check **5+ Burn** — favour those coins when stacked.
- Build **Poise Count** and **Potency** for crits and Coin Power scaling before committing **Take the Hit to the Last Blow, Please?** — **S1 — Fa Jin** adds **+3 Poise Count** at **On Use**; **S2 — Virescent Flame Palm** adds **+3 Poise** on **Clash Win** and **+2 Poise Count** per **On Hit** coin.
- **Take the Hit to the Last Blow, Please?** is your highest-damage skill — use the setup skills above first, then commit it once stacks are up.
- **Haste** raises Speed for next turn — several bonuses here require being faster than the target.
- Hold S3 for when At 6+ (Poise on self + Burn on target) is met — that condition is what unlocks its full damage ceiling.

**S1 — Fa Jin** (BP 6, CP +7, 1 coin): rolls — low 6, high 13 (Extremely High).
- If this unit's Speed is faster than the target's by 2 or more, Coin Power +1 ; [On Use] Clash Power +1 for every 6 (Poise on self + Burn on target) (max 2) ; [On Use] If target does not have Nerve Strike — Hong Lu, Clash Power +1 ; [On Use] Gain +3 Poise Count
- Peak output requires both conditions: Inflict 1 Burn | [On Hit] If target has 3+ Nerve Strike — Hong Lu, Reuse this Coin (once per Skill).

**S2 — Virescent Flame Palm** (BP 6, CP +5, 1 coin): rolls — low 6, high 11 (Extremely Low).
- Peak output requires both conditions: If this unit's Speed is faster than the target's, gain Coin Power based on Speed difference (Coin Power +1 for every 2 Speed difference | max 2).
- Gain +2 Poise Count; [On Hit] Inflict 2 Burn

**S3 — Take the Hit to the Last Blow, Please?** (BP 5, CP +4, 2 coins): rolls — low 5, high 13 (Low / Slightly Low stacked).
- Peak output requires both conditions: If this unit's Speed is faster than the target's by 2 or more, Coin Power +1 | [On Use] At 6+ (Poise on self + Burn on target), Coin Power +1.
- Deal +(Poise on self + Burn on target)% damage on Critical Hit (max 20%); [On Hit] Inflict +1 Burn Count; [On Crit] Inflict 2 Defense Level Down (2 times per turn); [On Hit] If target has Nerve Strike — Hong Lu, Reuse this Coin (once per Skill); [Reuse - On Hit] Deal Wrath damage equal to (Burn on target x 2)% of this Coin's final damage (max 40%)

Combat passive — **A Duel Witnessed**: Upon entering the Encounter for the first time, gain Witnessed — Eastern Cinq equal to the number of "" Identities set as Backup or Suppo….
  - Against the target a Base Attack Skill hit last, inflict 1 Nerve Strike — Hong Lu next turn (once per turn.
  - in Focused Encounters, the Part).

Combat passive — **Virescent Pyrojade**: On Clash Win, if target has Nerve Strike, inflict 1 Nerve Strike — Hong Lu (once per turn).
  - Turn End: Gain 1 Haste next turn for every 3 Poise Potency on self (max 2).
  - Deal +(Burn Potency on target)% damage on Critical Hit (max 15%).

Defense skill — **Counter: Light as a Tuft of Cloud**: If this unit's Speed is faster than the attacker's by 2 or more, Coin Power +1.
  - [Combat Start] Gain +3 Poise Count (once per turn).
